title: fix(core): actionErrorDetail shows a flat refusal's message, not its bare error code
body:
Fixes #37081
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在控制台里，会话失效后某个操作或设置页被拒时，报错不再显示「UNAUTHENTICATED」这个代号，而是显示一句「需要登录才能访问」的英文说明。
- 为什么做：属于“报错要说人话”的体验改进，替所有读这类拒绝答复的设置页与操作按钮解决同一个问题。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是某条报错显示的句子与以前不同（仍是服务器给的原句），不影响数据；可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

`actionErrorDetail` (`@object-ui/core`) returned a bare-string `error` before it read `message`. The REST seam's flat 401 body (`ANONYMOUS_DENY_BODY`, `packages/core/src/security/anonymous-deny.ts`) is `{error: 'UNAUTHENTICATED', code: 'UNAUTHENTICATED', message: 'Authentication is required to access this endpoint.'}`, so every caller showed the user the machine code.

Now, when the body carries both a non-empty string `error` and a non-empty string `message`, the message wins. Everything else keeps today's order:

- `{error: 'sentence'}` alone still returns the sentence (the legacy `/actions` shape).
- `{error: {message}}` (the ADR-0112 nested envelope) is read as before, and still ahead of a top-level `message`. No body shape on the platform was found that carries both a nested `error.message` and a different top-level `message`, so that order is kept.
- An empty or non-string `message` beside a string `error` returns the `error`; nothing readable returns the caller's fallback.

Callers (all read through this one function, none changed): `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`, `FlowItemMoreMenu.tsx`, `sharing-rule-catalog.ts`, `catalog-activation.ts`, `permission-set-clone.ts`, `packagedActionLedger.ts`, `connectorConnections.ts`, `connectorCredentials.ts`, `packagedFlowLedger.ts`, `flowResponse.ts` (app-shell) and `actionResponse.ts` (core).

Files to read first:
1. `ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionErrorDetail.ts` — the one changed branch (the bare-string `error` case).
2. `ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/actionErrorDetail-37081.test.ts` — the pins.

Two-minute verification: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/actionErrorDetail-37081.test.ts` — expect 5 passed.

## Tests

New file `actionErrorDetail-37081.test.ts` (no existing harness pins `actionErrorDetail` directly), five cases: the flat 401 body returns its message; `{error: 'sentence'}` alone returns the sentence; empty or non-string `message` returns the `error`; the nested envelope is unchanged and still beats a top-level `message`; lone `message` and the fallback are unchanged.

Flipped pins: none. No existing test asserted the code-over-message order. Two checks: a static scan of every `ui/**` test for an object literal carrying both a string `error` and a string `message` found 8 hits, none routed through `actionErrorDetail` (the `data-objectstack` and `AuditLogPage` / `PackagesPage` fixtures use their own readers); and the 113 test files that name a caller module or the code `UNAUTHENTICATED` in app-shell / console all pass with the change.

Received: "UNAUTHENTICATED"`, 1 failed / 4 passed; restore verified blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `@object-ui/core` does not depend on `@objectstack/core`, so the pin copies `ANONYMOUS_DENY_BODY` field for field and names its source file.
